# =============================================================================
# Workforce / Shift Scheduling MILP
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   x[s] : number of workers assigned to shift s
#          index set  S = {1,2,3,4}   domain: NonNegativeIntegers
#
# Objective (minimize)
#   Total daily wage cost = sum_s cost[s] * x[s]
#
# Constraints (one per time window t, indexed 1..8)
#   (1) Coverage: sum_s coverage[s,t] * x[s] >= required[t]
#       "the company meets the demand in each time window"
# =============================================================================

DATA = {
    # Eight consecutive 3-hour time windows (6 a.m. -> 6 a.m.)
    "periods": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8],
    # Four work shifts, each covering 3 consecutive windows (with wrap-around)
    "shifts": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    # Coverage matrix a[s, t] = 1 if shift s covers window t.
    # Shift 1: windows 1,2,3 ; Shift 2: windows 3,4,5 ;
    # Shift 3: windows 5,6,7 ; Shift 4: windows 7,8,1 (wrap-around).
    "coverage": {
        (1, 1): 1, (1, 2): 1, (1, 3): 1,
        (2, 3): 1, (2, 4): 1, (2, 5): 1,
        (3, 5): 1, (3, 6): 1, (3, 7): 1,
        (4, 7): 1, (4, 8): 1, (4, 1): 1,
    },
    # Workers required in each time window
    "required": {
        1: 55, 2: 46, 3: 59, 4: 23,
        5: 60, 6: 38, 7: 20, 8: 30,
    },
    # Wage rate per 9 h shift
    "cost": {1: 135, 2: 140, 3: 190, 4: 188},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets -------------------------------------------------------------
    model.S = pyo.Set(initialize=d["shifts"], ordered=True)
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"], ordered=True)

    # --- Decision variables ----------------------------------------------
    # x[s] = number of workers assigned to shift s (integer, >= 0)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.S, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # --- Objective --------------------------------------------------------
    # Minimize total wage cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["cost"][s] * m.x[s] for s in m.S)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # --- Constraints ------------------------------------------------------
    # (1) Coverage: each time window's demand must be met
    def coverage_rule(m, t):
        return sum(d["coverage"].get((s, t), 0) * m.x[s] for s in m.S) >= d["required"][t]

    model.coverage = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=coverage_rule)

    return model
